volumes.title: Unintended Consequences
volumes.subtitle: Fifty true stories of good intentions gone spectacularly wrong
volumes.author: Nerra Network
volumes.description: Cobra bounties that bred more cobras. A nuclear phase-out that imported coal by wire. Prohibition's gift to organized crime. Twenty true, carefully reconstructed stories of policies, inventions, and plans that achieved the exact opposite of what their designers intended — each one traced from the good intention, through the mechanism that turned it inside out, to the lesson that travels. Fifty stories, compiled from the Unintended Consequences podcast.
